detail.longDescription: I am looking way on development that allows me to divide adding features or code without show it as branch on git repository. For example, adding system login on my website. First I will handle frontend forms and make its styles, then should handle backend codes with its database schema. Sometimes, I am finishing frontend on branch login but not complete the backend. So, how can I push this branch before merge it to master or develop (testing branch) without show it on repository. I want in my repository be clean by release version numbers, master as latest, and develop as testing before release.
